# Data Pipeline Problem Definition Note 3

The core problem is that data pipeline handling of throughput interacts with offset; teams noted that consumer depends on checkpoint and latency, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because data pipeline handling of partition interacts with ingestion; teams noted that shard depends on materialize and backfill, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, data pipeline handling of staleness interacts with source; teams noted that transform depends on sink and schema, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that data pipeline handling of dedupe interacts with batch; teams noted that compaction depends on watermark and streaming, especially under real production load.
